sections.what_happened: Saree claims a ballistic missile struck the Saudi-led coalition's operations room at Badr camp in Aden — 'precise and direct.' AFP corroborates a Ansar Allah-missile blast near the airport (3rd attack on Aden seat of power in a week: Friday's airport-perimeter missiles, the Maashiq palace strike, now Badr camp). Yemeni officials: two rockets landed ~500m from a departing passenger plane; airport ops suspended, no casualties on tarmac. Separately: Shabwa province authorities raise the camp-strike toll to 73 dead (14 missing), resolving the 58 (Al Jazeera) vs 73 (JFeed) conflict toward the higher official figure. Coalition says 4 drones intercepted over Medina and Eastern regions; Saree denies any drones/operations toward Saudi Arabia. Yemen's recognized government added 135 people, firms and vessels to its terror-financing list (incl. 5 tankers, one UAE-based firm alleged to smuggle oil to Ansar Allah).
sections.what_verified: AFP police/security sources confirm a Ansar Allah-caused blast at/near the airport; Al Jazeera, Al Arabiya, MEE, FMT, Hurriyet, Straits Times independently carry the strike; Shabwa provincial authorities (via tob.news/AFP) confirm the 73 figure.
sections.what_disputed: Coalition's 4-drone claim vs Saree's denial — held as contested. Casualty figures in Yemen are routinely revised; the 14 missing add uncertainty. Saree's 'Saudi enemy gatherings' framing vs local officials' 'recruits in training' framing.
sections.why_matters: FMT's own framing: 'sustained Ansar Allah attacks on Saudi Arabia and Yemen's government have shifted the focus of the wider Middle East war.' The second theater is becoming the first — and the Shabwa toll (73) is the war's deadliest single strike in months.
sections.context: Background: Yemen/Saudi second theater — NEW in window (Oct 21): Ansar Allah ballistic missile hits Saudi operations room at Badr camp, Aden (smoke near airport; third attack in a week on the seat of the Saudi-backed government). Shabwa camp strike toll raised to 73 dead by provincial authorities (resolves the 58-vs-73 conflict). Coalition claims 4 drones intercepted over Medina/Eastern regions; Saree denies. Yemen govt adds 135 names/vessels to terror-finance list.

totw_analysis: Our read: FMT's own framing: 'sustained Ansar Allah attacks on Saudi Arabia and Yemen's government have shifted the focus of the wider Middle East war.' The second theater is becoming the first — and the Shabwa toll (73) is the war's deadliest single strike in months. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Is the Ansar Allah strike campaign on Saudi Arabia a pressure lever forcing Riyadh to break with Washington's blockade — or a separate war that risks trapping Gulf oil alongside Hormuz?
